title: Accumulate unequal micro-batches by valid tokens
prompt: Backpropagate a global VALID-TOKEN mean using precomputed micro-batch per-token loss tensors and Boolean masks. Return detached loss. Sum each selected loss then divide by total valid tokens; ignore all-masked micro-batches. Caller zeroes gradients and steps optimizer. This single-process core does not apply a hidden DDP scale factor.
